B_kinetic_sign_statement: For a static metric with g_tt g_rr = -1 sourced by canonical-or-phantom scalars, kappa eps f phi'^2 = -2 f R''/R, so the kinetic sign eps = -sign(R'') (f>0). Each throat (R''>0) needs eps = -1 (phantom), each belly (R''<0) eps = +1: a single scalar with kinetic function h(phi) must change sign at every inflection point (h = 0 there): the kinetic term of perturbations vanishes (infinite coupling); two throats need at least two such zero crossings.
